_doc: The mayor as a living person (Systems/Mayoralty.cs). Hit points are hp.base + hp.perLevel per level past the first, plus the Constitution modifier each level (at least 1 a level); they heal heal of the most a day, or all at once with a temple. Stances: keep (out of reach, nothing gained), town (walks the streets: mandate a day, loyalty from heroes, but assassins come for the mayor with assassin share of their blows and each breach in a siege wounds them with breach chance) and ride (goes with the next company to march: edge on its checks and blows, xp when it comes home, xpCleared if it cleared the place; each fallen companion is perDead chance of a wound, and a wiped company takes the mayor with it, body and all). Wounds are a share of the most hit points between the two numbers given. A dead mayor can be raised at the temple for raise.cost + raise.perLevel a level from the treasury unless the body was lost; otherwise the council names a successor from candidates rolled mayors, who starts with successorXp of the dead mayor's XP. Until then Mandate falls by leaderless a day, and after decideDays the council chooses for the player (the stand-in chooses at once: raise if it can pay with reserve to spare). Hardcore (New game): the mayor's death ends the campaign.
